title: Concept: JBoss version disclosed in a response
description: A JBoss version string in an error page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The version identifies the application server release, which has its own console and deserialisation advisories an attacker can look up.
applicability: Deployments that render a JBoss version string in an error page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The version identifies the application server release, which has its own console and deserialisation advisories an attacker can look up.
